character: Olympia Myklos and the snake oil
voice: Cheerfully morbid, scientifically matter-of-fact, and socially disarming; Steve's scars remain an intentional setup for their following encounter.

entries.text: Good. It gets the blood moving, doesn't it?
I see you found my snake oil.
I'm sure you meant no harm.
What is the snake oil for?
It repels snakes, of course. It is useful when I work in the basement. I lost several Egyptian cobras down there a few weeks ago, and now and then I encounter one of the little darlings.
They always want to bite me, but I am sure they mean nothing by it. Snakes are nervous creatures. Ordinarily, I love to watch them kill. My Barney will sink his teeth into anything.
I must run. I'm meeting that young Steve Dorian; he promised to show me his scars. Until later.
